reasons: Deviation is correctly identified: Section 2.1 is an express multi-year (three-year, USD 2,000,000/yr) take-or-pay with no reduction or termination right, which is the rule's walk-away position.

The redline reaches the preferred position (fees for Services used or ordered only; no minimum, take-or-pay, or shortfall obligation) and, because the entire operative obligation must be removed, the 100% changed-character ratio is expected rather than a minimality failure.
The replacement language is directionally correct for the Customer and internally consistent with the defined terms (Customer, Services); it does not introduce new obligations on us.
The comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice with the [Playbook] prefix, explains the change, and offers the 12-month reducible commitment with true-up as the fallback.

Minor caveat: the cross-references to Sections 9.4 and 12.3 are not verifiable from the supplied paragraphs — confirm those section numbers before sending, but the substance of the edit stands regardless.
